task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use your left arm to grab the drinking mug with smooth body, rotate it, set it down, then hang on the angular rack with slanted support rod.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住杯体光滑的饮水杯，旋转，放下，然后挂在带有倾斜支撑杆的角架上。
